lines.zh: 沿着废墟移动，枪口冒烟
lines.en: Move through ruins, smoke from rifle.

lines.zh: 枪口指向天空，扣动扳机

lines.en: Under the brass mask, the breathing is rough.
I swap a magazine while walking.

lines.zh: 坐在地上，火枪放在膝上
倚靠残垣，枪口指向四方

lines.en: Lean on wall, rifle on shoulder.
Stand by wall, rifle slightly raised.
Aim at player, prepare to shoot.

lines.zh: 观察玩家，枪口指向他们
瞄准玩家，扣动扳机射击
目光锁定玩家，扣动扳机
观察玩家，手指扣动扳机
瞄准玩家，扣动扳机开火
看向玩家，扣动扳机射击
枪管烫得握不住，我靠着墙。
lines.en: The barrel is too hot to hold; I slump against the wall.
Shrapnel is still lodged between my ribs.

lines.zh: 肋骨断了一根，呼吸都带哨音。
lines.en: A rib is broken; my breath whistles.
That old gun won't scare me!
Get closer, and you'll die faster!

lines.zh: 不要碰我，否则你会后悔！
lines.en: Don't touch me, or you'll regret it!

lines.zh: 我的黄铜面具价值连城！
火器是我的武器，你不懂！
lines.en: My gun is my weapon, you don't get it!

lines.zh: 你无法伤害我，我的护甲坚不可摧！
lines.en: You can't hurt me, my armor is unbreakable!

lines.zh: 我的枪膛里装满了子弹！
lines.en: My gun is loaded with bullets!

lines.zh: 不要逼我动手，你会死得很惨！
lines.en: Don't逼 me to act, you'll die horribly!

lines.zh: 你撞上我了，现在轮到你了！
lines.en: You hit me, now it's your turn!

lines.zh: 黄铜面具替我挡了一下。
lines.en: The brass mask took that hit for me.

lines.zh: 别傻了，我不会被你打败！

lines.en: My gun is faster than your sword.

lines.zh: 你撞歪我的枪口，我立刻抬正。
lines.en: You knock my muzzle aside; I level it again.
Don't touch me, or there'll be trouble!

lines.zh: 我的枪口对着你，投降吧！
lines.en: My gun is on you, surrender!

lines.zh: 找到我的同伴，我们会更强！
lines.en: Find my mate, we'll be stronger!

lines.zh: 让我们一起战斗，胜利属于我们！
lines.en: Let's fight together, victory is ours!

lines.zh: 我的黄铜面具能保护我的伴侣！
lines.en: My brass mask protects my mate!

lines.zh: 黏土球，我的伴侣也需要！
lines.en: Clay balls, my mate needs them too!

lines.zh: 我的力量来自我的伴侣！
lines.en: My strength comes from my mate!

lines.zh: 我的火器是伴侣间的武器！
lines.en: My gun is a weapon between mates!

lines.zh: 我的护甲可以保护我的伴侣！
我的枪声是战斗的号角！
lines.en: My gun is the battle's call!

lines.zh: 找到我的伴侣，共同战斗！
背靠背吧，我信你的枪法。
lines.en: Back to back, then; I trust your aim.

lines.zh: 黄铜面具底下，我瞄着你。
lines.en: Under this brass mask, I aim at you.
My iron sight settles on your chest.
The wind drifts left. One notch of correction.

lines.zh: 你的头盔挡不住这一发。
lines.en: Your helmet will not stop this round.
The smell of black powder drifts over.
The one holding a gun goes first.
Target locked, don't let him escape.

lines.zh: 瞄准目标，确保一击即中。
lines.en: Aim for the target, hit hard.

lines.zh: 锁定目标，小心不要误伤。
lines.en: Target locked, be careful not to hit wrong.
Aim for the target, precise shot.
Forty health is enough to outlast you.
Two armor points will hold off a knife.
The barrel is still hot. Patience.
Did you hear the bolt slide?
I hit fine without a scope.
In the smoke, I change position.

lines.zh: 你的铁甲在铜弹前会响。
lines.en: Your iron armor will ring against brass rounds.

lines.zh: 掩体后面，我数你的呼吸。
lines.en: Behind cover, I count your breaths.
The second shot goes into your leg.
Don't raise that shield. You won't lift it in time.
Sssss! Get out of my way!
Your flesh will do me good.
My pistol's at your ribs — don't move.
Move, I’m going to eat you!

lines.zh: 我咬住你握枪的手，牙齿发黄。
lines.en: I sink yellow teeth into your shooting hand.

lines.zh: 枪托砸下来，比子弹还近。
lines.en: The rifle butt comes down, closer than any bullet.

lines.zh: 我撕开你的衣领，为的是你口袋。
lines.en: I rip your collar open for what's in your pockets.
Move, I want to eat you!
The stock cracks against your jaw.
A casing hits the ground with a chime.
That shot pushed you back two steps.
Behind the brass mask, I am smiling.
Reloading takes three seconds. You have less.
Magazine empty. I use the knife.

lines.zh: 我从废土的战壕里爬起来，枪上膛。
lines.en: I climb out of a wasteland trench, gun loaded.
The barrel is colder than my arm.
My domain is in the decay!
Rotten flesh and clay make me.

lines.zh: 黑火药的味道里，我来了。
lines.en: I come with the smell of black powder.
My brass mask is hot to the touch.

lines.zh: 从废楼摔下，黄铜面具磕歪了。
lines.en: I fall from the ruin and my brass mask knocks askew.

lines.zh: 水灌进面具，火枪沉了下去。
lines.en: Water fills my mask; the gun sinks away.

lines.zh: 气浪掀翻我，面具里全是耳鸣。
lines.en: The blast flips me; my mask rings with noise.

lines.zh: 紫光烧过面具，金属在发烫。
lines.en: Violet light sears my mask and the metal grows hot.
Too hungry to hold the gun steady.
My brass mask is hot with current.
